skill_name: Describe the focus of the Nobel Prize.
workflow: The Nobel Prize is a set of international awards presented annually in recognition of great achievement in literature, physics, chemistry, peace, economics, and physiology or medicine. It is one of the most prestigious awards in the world and is awarded to individuals who have made a difference in their field and who have demonstrated a commitment to the betterment of humanity.
